shared_elements: large bird in profile with striated/hatched wing
animals stacked in superposed horizontal registers on a tall vertical surface
horizontal band of repeated pattern separating registers
justification: Both surfaces present a tall vertical field divided into superposed registers in which schematic profile animals \u0097 notably a big-beaked bird with a linearly striated wing, snaky sinuous bodies and repeated predator heads in a row \u0097 are stacked one above another, with a band of repeated motifs acting as a divider; this combination of stacked animal registers plus a dominant bird is a fairly specific correspondence. The chief differences are that A's central motif is a pair of interlaced/crossed sinuous bodies flanked by heads and a strictly mirror-symmetrical pair of confronted birds, whereas B distributes its creatures asymmetrically across the field with a descending quadruped and a long-necked bird and no confronted mirror pairing.
